articles.summary: RetailMeNot, a leading savings and cash back destination, is celebrating its 20th anniversary. As a pioneer in digital savings, RetailMeNot is marking two decades of innovation with a more seamless, AI-powered approach to shopping that brings together trusted deals, cash back, and inspiration across the entire purchase journey, guiding consumers from discovery to decision with greater speed and confidence.
articles.title: From Coupon Code to Shopping Companion: RetailMeNot Celebrates 20 Years of Savings
